title: FIG. 01 · The Room, Re-set
summary: This is the founder's brief, built literally. Round-1 hero A keeps its frosted room, its real nav and its FIG. band. The statement now sits on two lines in Plurel's family cadence ('Revenue is an / architectural problem.', with the light accent on 'problem.') and is held almost at the vertical centre, left-aligned. The lede and both doors move to the bottom-right and the fixed-scope note moves to the bottom-left, so the eye travels diagonally from the statement to the action. Three small touches come from C's observed room: corner registration marks, a calibrated film ruler and a timecode.

reference.site: Round 1 · A + C (hero A 'FIG. 01 · The Room', with a little of hero C 'Sheet 01 · Observed Room')
reference.borrowed: From hero A: the whole room. That means the warm frosted film cropped height-fit, so the man seen from behind, the standing colleague and the seated one gather on the right. It also means the tracked-caps nav with the lockup and the outlined AUDIT REQUEST ↗, the margin-to-margin hairlines, the red-square label, the 48×2 red rule, the two doors, the quiet fixed-scope note, and the FIG. 01 band with Close | Wide and Pause film. From hero C, only three things: registration marks at the frame's corners, a measured film strip, and one mono value.
reference.kelwin: The founder's notes are applied literally. (1) The statement is two lines: 'Revenue is an' / 'architectural' at weight 430, then 'problem.' in light 300 at --fg-2 on the same line. This is Plurel's 'Made to be / seen. Everywhere.' cadence at 116px Mona wide, running to col 11. (2) It is held almost at the vertical centre: its centre sits at about 45% of the 776px body, left-aligned at col 1, with the label 36px above and the red rule 40px below. (3) The lede and the two doors (red REQUEST A SYSTEM AUDIT ↗ and underlined TALK TO THE TEAM →) move to the bottom-right in cols 8–12, where the note used to be. Their bottoms sit 48px above the band. The door pair spans the whole bay: the primary sits on the col-8 line, and the secondary's arrow lands flush on the right margin, on the same edge as AUDIT REQUEST and PAUSE FILM. (4) '■ A FIXED-SCOPE DIAGNOSTIC · Ten working days. Clear findings. Actionable recommendations.' moves to the bottom-left in cols 1–4. Its last baseline sits exactly on the primary button's bottom edge, the strongest horizontal at the foot of the act. (5) A little observed room, and no more: four registration marks (+) where the nav and band hairlines meet the margins. The film-progress hairline becomes a calibrated tick ruler, one tick per second of the 32s loop with a major tick every fifth, and the elapsed run reads in --fg. One mono timecode sits beside the controls. There are no column verticals, coordinates, cell nav or spec cells, and nothing is drawn over the people. The film keeps round-1 A's calibration (blur 8px, frost .20, grain .5), and the scrim is re-cut for the new layout: the left falls off later, a light lane sits behind the two lines, and the floor deepens under the bottom corners. The upper right stays open, which is where the room shows. All of it is built from kit-ac components: .ac-head, .ac-statement--hero, .ac-label, .ac-rule, .ac-lede, .ac-doors, .ac-btn, .ac-link, .ac-note, .ac-btn-o, .ac-seg, .ac-cap and .ac-reg. Red appears only on the primary button, the rule and the two label squares.

motion: entrance (≤ 1.6s, --ease-out): the film fades up from graphite on the Close crop (1.2s) while the nav hairline draws left to right. The four registration marks fade in at the frame corners (300–540ms). The kit's head choreography, shifted by 240ms, then runs: the label fades in, 'Revenue is an' rises out of its mask, and 'architectural problem.' follows 200ms later. The red rule draws, then the lede and the doors at bottom-right fade up 12px together with the note at bottom-left. The band hairline draws, and the caption, controls and timecode fade in while the ruler calibrates, drawing left to right over 900ms.

orchestrated moment: at 2.4s the camera pulls back once from the close framing to the wide one over 1.6s --ease-inout (scale + translate on the plate) to reveal the three people behind and beside the statement. This is round-1 A's establishing shot, kept because the founder chose it.

ambient: only the film loops. That means the 32s drift, a silhouette crossing, and the frosted-glass grain. The timecode advances with the film (00:00 → 00:32, one change per second), and the ruler's elapsed run fills one tick per second in --fg. Both belong to the film, and both stop when it is paused. Nothing else moves.

on the live site: the plate is the background <video>, and the ruler and timecode read its currentTime. The pull-back runs once on load. Reduced motion shows the Wide resting frame with no entrance, and the timecode holds still.
interaction: 'Pause film' really pauses the drift, the walker, the grain, the timecode and the ruler, and flips to 'Play film'. The Close | Wide control is gone.
notes: The stage is 960px: 96 nav + 776 body + 88 band. At 116px with the spec tracking, 'architectural problem.' measures about 1,174px and ends at x 1238 (col 11), so the statement spans cols 1–12 and is never clipped by its rise masks. In the Kelwin skin it ends at x 1162. The lede stays at the kit's 20px and wraps to three lines in cols 8–12. The doors fit side by side in that span and are justified across it (843 → 1376 in both skins). Round-2 review fix: they used to stop 5px short of the margin (32px in the Kelwin skin), a near-miss beside the margin-aligned nav action and Pause film. The note's last baseline was also moved onto the primary's bottom edge (823.8 vs 824). The lede/doors block sits on the col-8 line rather than under the start of 'problem.' (x ≈ 777), because grid alignment holds in both skins and type alignment does not. The founder's 'almost vertically centred' is read as a centre at ≈45% of the body, not 50%. The bottom-right block needs ~180px, and a true centre would crowd it under 'problem.'. The C touches stay at three (marks, ruler, timecode), per DIRECTION-AC §3.4. · Promoted unchanged from round-2 slot X. · Round 3 (D12): the Close | Wide framing control is removed; the film rests on Wide after its one establishing pull-back. Pause film stays (WCAG 2.2.2).
addressed: Approved in round 2 — kept as is.

story: The claim and the room, said once: “Revenue is an architectural problem.” After this the page stops asserting and starts showing.
